node.title: Mapping — 'is this surveillance?' → repo/system-level governance
node.summary: Maps the surveillance fear to the discipline that everything lands at repo/system level — context, flags, traces, policy — never individual keystrokes.
node.interview_question: What technically prevents a customer from using your data to rank or monitor individual engineers?

competitor.name: DX (Atlassian)
competitor.positioning: The anti-pattern is older developer-productivity/surveillance tooling that ranks individuals; Faros must visibly distance itself from that whole category.
